Greeting.title: Greeting
Greeting.description: An interactive Diwali greeting document containing recipient metadata, blessing message, compressed mandala rangoli vector JSON, and reaction counters.

id.description: 8-character alphanumeric short ID for the greeting.

recipientName.description: First name of the recipient (sanitized and length-limited).

recipientLang.description: ISO code of the blessing language.

recipientTone.description: Relationship register or poetic tone of the blessing.

messageTranslation.description: Optional English companion translation when written in Hindi, Bengali, or Marathi.

rangoliSymmetry.description: Number of radial symmetry axes (6, 8, or 12).

rangoliPalette.description: Comma-separated hex color palette used in the mandala.

rangoliStrokesJson.description: Ramer-Douglas-Peucker simplified base strokes serialized as compact normalized JSON.

opensCount.description: Number of times the greeting ritual link was opened.

litCount.description: Number of times recipients ignited the diya and sent a Diya Lit reaction.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the greeting was published.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the greeting counters were last updated.

/greetings/{greetingId}.description: Stores published DiyaVerse greetings indexed by their unguessable 8-character short ID.
